name: Views Infinite Scroll With Pager
description: A Views pager plugin that renders a full numeric pager alongside Views Infinite Scroll, so the display stays crawlable and usable without JavaScript.
project_description:
Views Infinite Scroll With Pager adds a new Views pager plugin (id infinite_scroll_with_pager) that extends the Views Infinite Scroll pager and renders a standard numeric pager beneath the scroll button. Infinite scroll keeps working for visitors with JavaScript, while the pager gives every page of the result set a real URL, so crawlers can index deep pages and non-JS/keyboard users can navigate the whole list. It is configured entirely on the view: pick the pager type on the Pager settings and set the number of visible links and the first/previous/next/last labels.

 Note: the view must have the " Use AJAX " option set to " Yes " under Advanced for the infinite-scroll behaviour to work.

 Dependencies: 
 Views Infinite Scroll
